thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel selection tweak landed on canary yesterday I'm seeing token/sec drop on gpu-pool-g36 (dedicated). Median batch size fell ~45% over two hours, queue depth spiked briefly, then KV-cache eviction increased. Posting details.
liam: Oof. Is this the change to prefer int8 kernels for long sequences? Any chance batching heuristics started pruning queues earlier?
maria: Yes, the kernel selector now biases int8 for sequences >1024. But it also updates the batch formation policy to prefer shorter seqs when token budget target is hit. I think the token-budget gating + aggressive queue-pruning is creating lots of small batches.
sam: Can you paste the telemetry snippets? curious about partial batch % and per-gpu token/sec.
maria: Attaching quick metrics (from last 10m):
```
- avg_batch_size: 7.8 (was 14.1)
- partial_batch_pct: 62%
- queue_depth_p95: 48 -> 12 after pruning spike
- tokens/sec/gpu: 4200 -> 2700
- kvcache_hitrate: 0.72 -> 0.41
```
ana: kvcache_hitrate drop is big — if KV eviction policy changed (LRU window) we could be losing long-prefix reuse, which explodes token generation on cold starts and forces smaller coalesced batches.
liam: That matches. If prefix reuse falls, many requests present as independent short sequences and batcher groups less. Thoughts on dashboarding to spot this earlier?
maria: Proposed dashboard widgets:
  - time-series: tokens/sec/gpu (per-cluster & per-pool)
  - grouped bar: median batch size by model and region
  - gauge: partial_batch_pct with alert when >50% for 5m
  - heatmap: kvcache_hitrate by model version and node
  - histogram: coalesced sequence length distribution
  - derived: "effective_utilization" = avg_batch_size / max_batch_capacity
sam: Also add an alert rule: if effective_utilization < 0.3 AND queue_depth_p95 > 10 for 10m -> create pager and open a detective ticket. We should correlate with recent kernel_selector rollouts.
maria: Agreed. For quick investigation, here's the PromQL I used to compute effective_utilization:
```
(sum(batch_size_sum) by (gpu_pool) / sum(batch_count) by (gpu_pool)) / (avg(max_batch_capacity) by (gpu_pool))
```
liam: Nice. We should also capture the token-budget gating decisions in trace events so SRE can replay why a queue was pruned.
ana: And include kvcache eviction rate metric (evicts/sec) and a tag for eviction-reason (memory_pressure | TTL | manual) so we can correlate.
deploy-bot: deploy report: kernel-selector v2.4 rolled to canary at 2141598000, rollout -> 100% canary nodes 2141600000
maria: Next steps:
  1) Add the widgets and the two alerts (effective_utilization, kvcache_eviction_spike).
  2) Instrument kernel-selector to emit gating events into traces.
  3) Backfill short window (last 24h) for dashboards to tune thresholds.
liam: I'll own the dashboard cards. sam/ana can own the alert rules and eviction tags. I'll tag you on the PR.
sam: On it. I'll also add a one-off job to compute partial_batch correlation with kvcache_hitrate across models.
maria: Thanks. If we see similar regressions on staging, we'll rollback the kernel preference and iterate. :thumbsup:
